item.title: Byte Buddy vs Javassist vs ASM in 2026: Which JVM Bytecode Toolkit Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Something in your JVM is rewriting class files while your application runs. It might be your mocking library stubbing a final method, your APM agent weaving timers into service calls, or your ORM generating a proxy for lazy loading. Roughly 40% of the libraries in a typical Maven dependency tree touch bytecode at some point, and nearly all of them pick one of three tools to do it: Byte Buddy, Javassist, or ASM.
